title: agoseris aurantiaca var. purpurea
intro: Agoseris aurantiaca var. purpurea, commonly known as the Purple Mariposa Daisy, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Agoseris aurantiaca var. purpurea include immune system modulation, antimicrobial activity, and wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
